# Field Station Handbook

This handbook records practical routines for a small research outpost. Equipment choices and maintenance instructions live on separate pages so readers must combine evidence rather than rely on a summary.

Start with [water storage](cistern.md), [rationing](rationing.md), [heat buffers](thermal-mass.md), or [night ventilation](night-purge.md). The [garden](garden.md) and [workshop](workshop.md) cover unrelated daily activities.
